title: PQ source mapped to an SDR destination with a gamut matrix that ignores the different luminance of 1.0 (10000 nits vs 203 nits)
expected_finding: gammaDecodeParams is the PQ EOTF, whose output 1.0 means 10000 nits, while gammaEncodeParams is the sRGB inverse EOTF, whose input 1.0 means SDR white (203 nits); gamutConversionMatrix = XYZToRGB_sRGB * RGBToXYZ_Rec2020 carries no 10000/203 factor, so a 203-nit grey lands at 0.0203 and the picture is about 50x too dark
